protocol: Final seeds5101–5130 remain untouched until settings are frozen.
Actor and critic never receive true target motion or acceleration.
Reverse task uses a prespecified five-step window; other cases use ten.
Dynamics/geometry and sensor shifts are evaluated separately, then composed.
Return is configuration-specific; compare physical task and tracking metrics across reward variants.

crossing.description: Held-out equal-altitude crossing instance within the randomized crossing geometry family.

shifted_goals.description: Unseen, closer goals within the same flight volume.

reverse_goals.description: Held-out simultaneous reverse goals; randomized training includes one reverse goal at a time.

wide_fast.description: Both bounds and speed changed; all other task parameters fixed.

target_velocity.description: Held-out faster target velocity; navigation unchanged.

target_turn.description: Unseen hidden acceleration change after six steps; CV filter unchanged.

noisy_measurements.description: Measurement floors outside the training ranges; filter knows sensor noise.

strict_upload.description: Known upload SINR threshold above the training range.

composed_shift.description: Held-out combination of crossing geometry, faster UAV, maneuvering target, noisy CSI and strict upload.

bs_only.description: Nominal geometry, BS updates only: isolate value of UAV measurement fusion.

prediction_only.description: Nominal geometry, identical prior, prediction only: no measurement updates.

wide_bounds.description: Only enlarge bounds; keep starts, goals, time, and speed fixed.

fast_speed.description: Only increase speed limit from 5 to 8 m/s; acceleration remains 5 m/s虏.

target_position.description: Held-out target initial position; original velocity retained.
